title: Turán's problem for hypergraphs

model_contract.hypothesis: The 3-uniform hypergraph has the required number of vertices and no forbidden complete subhypergraph.
model_contract.conclusion: Its edge count is at most the stated extremal bound.
model_contract.counterexample_condition: The 3-uniform hypergraph has the required number of vertices and no forbidden complete subhypergraph. and NOT (Its edge count is at most the stated extremal bound.)
model_contract.witness: A sorted list of triples, together with the checked forbidden subsets and edge count.

verification_boundary: A candidate requires an independent verifier and a source-statement audit. No candidate within the recorded finite scope does not prove the conjecture.

notes: A finite search without a candidate is not a proof of the original unbounded statement.
